nodes.title: 1. Original brief (Text)
widgets_values: Create a short explanation for computing teachers: what happens when a student opens a website? Cover DNS lookup when the address is not cached, the HTTP request over an HTTPS connection, and the server response that the browser processes. Use three scenes. Keep it accurate and suitable for beginners.

nodes.title: 2. Generate a script (GenerateText)
widgets_values: You are a computing teacher. Write a short English video script with exactly three numbered scenes. Each scene has one main idea and one visual suggestion. Use at most 150 words in total. Explain the supplied topic accurately. Avoid invented facts and unnecessary jargon. Return only the script.

nodes.title: 3. Write narration and plan the images (GenerateText)
Review and save the three-scene plan (ShowText)
Read first (Note)
widgets_values: Preparation stage only: run, then review the script and the JSON scene plan. Check facts, English pronunciation and visual relevance. Copy the reviewed plan into the Text node of 10b-Production-Reviewed.json. This workflow generates no images or audio.
